modal.name: Name
modal.nameDesc: Leave empty to show only a colored label.
modal.hideGroupTip: Close the group's tabs but keep the group, so you can reopen it later from the settings or the command palette.
modal.deleteGroupTip: Close all tabs in the group and delete the group. This can't be undone.
modal.ungroupTip: Keep the tabs open as regular tabs and remove the group.
modal.newTabTip: Open a new tab at the end of the group.
modal.newWindowTip: Move the group with all its tabs to a new window.
settings.languageDesc: Language of the tab menu and group windows. Auto follows the Obsidian language.
settings.groupStyleDesc: How groups appear in the tab bar.
settings.labelTabCountDesc: Show how many tabs a group has, next to its name.
settings.removeEmptyGroups: Remove a group when its last tab closes
settings.removeEmptyGroupsDesc: When the last tab of a group is closed, delete the group too, like Chrome. When off, the group stays so you can add tabs to it again.
settings.lockGroupedTabsDesc: Keep the note in a grouped tab from being replaced. A note opened from it (link, file explorer, quick switcher) opens in a new tab outside the group; add that tab to the group from the tab menu to keep it. Tabs are not pinned, so they stay where they are.
settings.suggestGroupName: Suggest a name and color for new groups
settings.suggestGroupNameDesc: Fill in the folder of the tab's note as the name, with a color picked from that name, so the same folder gets the same color. You can still change both.
settings.groupsDesc: Hidden groups remember their tabs, so you can reopen them here. Delete the groups you no longer need.
settings.noGroups: No groups yet. Right-click a tab and select "Create tab group".
settings.deleteTip: Close the group's tabs and delete the group.
command.createGroup: Create tab group from the current tab
command.groupUngrouped: Create tab group from all ungrouped tabs
command.addToGroup: Add the current tab to a group
command.removeFromGroup: Remove the current tab from its group
command.toggleGroup: Collapse or expand the current tab's group
command.newTabInGroup: Open a new tab in the current tab's group
command.moveGroupToWindow: Move the current tab's group to a new window
settings.reopenTip: Open the saved tabs again as this group.
notice.missingTabs: {count} saved tabs couldn't be opened because their notes no longer exist.
notice.noFolderGroups: No folder has two or more ungrouped tabs in this pane.
confirm.deleteDesc: Close {count} open tabs and delete the group "{name}"? This can't be undone.
command.saveSet: Save the current groups as a set
modal.setNameDesc: Saving with the name of an existing set replaces it.
settings.groupSetsDesc: Saved sets of groups. Type a name under New set to save the current groups.
settings.openSetTip: Open this set's groups at the end of the current pane.
settings.deleteSetTip: Delete this saved set. Open tabs stay as they are.
